text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what in the world happened!? Agnes 
Tachyon will not take the victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her races so far, it was a 
lackluster run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well... a margin of error like 
this is within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"As if dragged down by that, Jungle 
Pocket, Dantsu Flame, and the others were 
also unable to seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tch, I miscalculated... My bad, Trainer...
choice_data_list: No, I should be the one apologizing...
No. I should be the one apologizing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to Agnes Tachyon's unexpected flop, 
the race results ended in total turmoil.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, there's something I need to tell 
you. Today, not yet—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to deciding who stands at 
the top—the leader of our generation— it's 
undeniably the next race, the Nippon 
Derby."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you at the very pinnacle! Only 
by doing that can I be the strongest of 
our generation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I see. Well, that makes sense. I 
want that too, after all. To beat you in 
the Derby. Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However, light converges where it 
ought to converge. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the end of a beginning, and the start 
of the next. See you, Pokke-kun.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't get this at all... Hey, Tachyon! 
You'd better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll damn well show 'em at the Japanese 
Derby. The roar of the demon, my most 
terrifying run!"
